decisions.reason: This underground mining loader line builds very directly on the firm's core underground-machine, safety and service knowledge, so absorptive capacity is high and continued improvement is more attractive than withdrawal.

While the construction dumper uses related vehicle and hydraulics know-how, it is less central to the firm's strongest specialized niches, so the learning benefits appear weaker than the value of shifting resources back to core lines and new development.

The inclined furniture lift fits the firm's established lifting, safety and maintenance capabilities well enough that customer feedback can likely be absorbed and converted into incremental product refinements.
The inclined building material lift is closely related to the firm's construction and lifting applications, giving it a strong knowledge base for adaptation, service support and further improvement.

The truck-mounted inclined furniture lift is somewhat riskier because vehicle integration adds complexity, but it still leverages the firm's lifting and specialized-equipment capabilities sufficiently to justify keeping it on the market.
